title: Intel Expects 14A performance to be within 5% of TSM's A14
gist: Per a KeyBanc meeting note, Intel Foundry's CTO expects 14A performance within 5% of TSMC's A14 and claims EMIB-T packaging leadership despite TSMC's CoPoS. The author flags a 2028 server part on 14A and capacity concerns tied to a 2029 Ohio ramp.

insights.claim: Intel Foundry EVP/CTO/GM Naga Chandrasekaran told KeyBanc that Intel expects its 14A node performance to be within 5% of TSMC's A14.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Gives a quantified competitive claim for Intel's 14A; track customer wins and PPA validation against it.
insights.quote: Expects 14A performance to be within 5% of TSM's A14

insights.claim: Intel is publicly quantifying its node performance relative to TSMC as a percentage range, which it has not previously done, despite 14A yields and ramp being described as extremely aggressive.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A willingness to commit to a number signals confidence, but aggressive yield and ramp targets raise execution risk.
insights.quote: Intel is finally sticking its neck out to say how their nodes compare with a % range to TSMC.

insights.claim: Intel says it is not afraid of TSMC's CoPoS packaging and sees sustained leadership in advanced packaging with EMIB-T even as TSMC introduces CoPoS.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Packaging is a competitive axis for foundry customers; watch EMIB-T versus CoPoS adoption.
insights.quote: Sees sustained leadership in advanced packaging with EMIB-T even with TSM introducing CoPoS

insights.claim: The KeyBanc note says Intel has a server part on 14A in 2028.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Sets a timeline for first server products on 14A; watch for slippage.

insights.claim: If a 14A server part arrives in 2028, Intel's Coral Rapids may not be on 18A-U and could instead be on 14A, though the author has capacity concerns.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Node assignment for Coral Rapids affects 18A-U versus 14A demand and capacity planning.
insights.quote: Coral Rapids might not be on 18A-U if that's the case.

insights.claim: The author sees 2029 as the big 14A ramp year, pointing towards Ohio volume in 2029, which underlies his capacity concerns for a 2028 server part.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Ohio fab timing is a gating factor for 14A volume; monitor fab milestones.
insights.quote: 2029 is the big ramp, pointing towards 2029 Ohio volume
